{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Deduplicate the data: keep the row with highest sample_seq for each patient_id
trial_dedup = trial.loc[trial.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify the deduplication
print('After deduplication:')
print('Number of unique patient_id values:', trial_dedup['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Number of rows:', len(trial_dedup))
print('Expected: 800 — matches unique patient_id count. Good.')

# Check severity distribution on deduplicated data
print('\nSeverity counts after deduplication:')
print(trial_dedup['severity'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
n_severe = trial_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
n_total = len(trial_dedup)
fraction_severe = n_severe / n_total

print(f'\nFraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe:.4f}')"}
